practicals.title: Practical-1
content: Write a program to print numbers, alphabets and special characters
on the output screen.

practicals.title: Practica-2
content: Write a program to check whether a number is even or odd.

practicals.title: Practical-3
content: Write a program that accept age in years from user and display age
in months and days.

practicals.title: Practical-4
content: Write a program to check whether a number is palindrome or not.

practicals.title: Practical-5
content: Write a program that demonstrate the use of arithmetic and
assignment operators by getting two numbers from user.

practicals.title: Practical-6
content: Write a program to calculate area of circle, square, rectangle and
triangle using switch-case statements.

practicals.title: Practical-7
content: Write a program that accept number from user and display all
factors of that number.

practicals.title: Practical-8
content: Write a program that accept number and find factorial.

practicals.title: Practical-9
content: Write a program that accept 9 numbers in matrix and display
transpose of matrix.

practicals.title: Practical-10
content: Write a program to count number of words in a sentence.

practicals.title: Practical-11
content: Write a program to create structure of book (Title, Author,
Publication, Price) and display records for N books.

practicals.title: Practical-12
content: Write a program for doing arithmetic operations using function that
program includes the following functions – Addition, Subtraction,
Multiplication, Division and Modulus.

practicals.title: Practical-13
content: Write a program to find GCD of two numbers using function.

practicals.title: Practical-14
content: Write a program to convert Fahrenheit to centigrade and centigrade
to Fahrenheit using function.

practicals.title: Practical-15
content: Write a program to create a class `Bank_Account` with data
members Depositor_Name, Acc_No, Acc_Type, and Balance, and
implement member functions for account creation, deposit,
withdrawal, and balance inquiry.

practicals.title: Practical-16
content: Write a program to create a class Sales that stores salesman name
and sales amount, and calculates commission as Rs. 10 per thousand
for sales = 25000 and Rs. 5 per thousand otherwise, then displays
the result

practicals.title: Practical-17
content: Define class Time containing following: 1. Data Members like:
Hours, Minutes and Seconds. 2. Member Functions like: Get time,
Display time and perform Sum of two time objects.

practicals.title: Practical-18
content: Write a program to calculate Volume of Box using Constructor.

practicals.title: Practical-19
content: Create class Person having: 1.Name 2.Nationality and also create a
Constructors like : 1. One constructor with two arguments 2. One
constructor with one argument

practicals.title: Practical-20
content: Write a program to demonstrate the concept of Destructor.

practicals.title: Practical-21
content: Write a program for Enter Patient details using Inheritance.

practicals.title: Practical-22
content: Write a program to show access to Private Public and Protected
using Inheritance.

practicals.title: Practical-23
content: Write a program to declare two classes each having one integer data
member and find sum using friend function.

practicals.title: Practical-24
content: Define two classes 12 HH and 24 HH to represent time and convert
one format to another using type conversion concept.

practicals.title: Practical-25
content: Write a C++ Program to Demonstrate try, catch block using
exception handling.

practicals.title: Practical-26
content: Write a program to Read and Write File Operation in File Handling.
Total Hours 56
